column2: WEEKLY PATTERN:  Odd weeks = Smith Bulgarian + Leg Press + Hip Abduction  |  Even weeks = DB Bulgarian + DB Sumo + Hip Adduction
1. Open your current WEEK sheet — all 4 days inside (ANT LEG / PUSH / PULL / POS LEG)
2. Log WEIGHT (kg) and REPS in yellow cells after each session
3. Form notes in last column — reference at gym
4. Pos Leg: Hip Abduction (odd weeks) / Hip Adduction (even weeks) — both machines usually side by side
5. Export each WEEK sheet as CSV and upload to GitHub every 8 weeks
6. Share GitHub raw URL with Claude for weight analysis and next cycle planning
